# ferriskey_user_attribute (Resource)

Manages a single custom attribute of a user. The API upserts attributes key by key (a PUT merges instead of replacing the whole map), so each attribute is its own resource and other attributes of the user are left untouched. Setting a key that already exists overwrites its value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ferriskey_user_attribute" "department" {
  realm   = "acme"
  user_id = ferriskey_user.alice.user_uuid
  key     = "department"
  value   = "engineering"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Attribute key. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `realm` (String) Name of the realm the user belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `user_id` (String) UUID of the user. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `value` (String) Attribute value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier `{realm}/{user_id}/{key}`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ferriskey_user_attribute.department acme/4b2d7f90-1111-2222-3333-444455556666/department
```
